additional_info.body:
Buongiorno Filomena,
I am writing you from the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0431995.
The ticket has been opened for an issue on charger
ibiw7N - 314015297001
to stop the charge.
I analyzed the logs of the timestamp and the SessionID that you reported to us:
The SessionID "475630131" started on DC2 on 2025-06-17T06:55:53
No issue was encountered during the charging process
The charging session was stopped by the EV
at 2025-06-17T08:04:21, because the EV reached 100% SOC.
The session ended without error, the OCPP StopTransaction was sent to the Backend with all information, and after 12 seconds the client removed the plug from the car (Pilotstate going to A).
In conclusion, I do not see any issue.
I will proceed to close the ticket
ID0431995.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
